name: Ultimaker 2 Extended

outputs.reason: Ultimaker 2 Extended export is not implemented. UltiGCode needs volumetric E and its own firmware-managed temperature/startup contract; S5 Griffin output is incompatible.

startup.validation: Original Ultimaker 2 Extended, not 2+, Extended+ or Connect. Firmware startup handoff is unresolved.

boundsBasis: 223 x 223 mm Cura coordinates and 305 mm Extended height. Selected-tool y=10..212 conservatively avoids front/rear glass clips; polygon-aware clip clearance is not implemented.
processBasis: PLA is an editable default; ABS is also declared. Temperature windows, 4 mm3/s flow and Bowden retraction limits are conservative SAAM starting choices, not material calibration. No nonplanar clearance is declared.
validation: Profile for geometry and setup review only; machine output and physical printing are unvalidated.
